text:
mike: quick check — running a canary in uk-west (europe-west2) this afternoon, need 4 A100 GPUs for ~2 hours. quota shows short. vendor says they can only deliver 1 rack in 48h. can anyone lend 2x A100s from a demo/standby pool? :pray:

sara: able to run a quick quota check? here's the command I use:```bash
gcloud compute regions describe europe-west2 --format='table(quotas.metric,quotas.limit,quotas.usage)'
```

jonathan: I can free 2 A100s by stopping the nightly inference smoke for an hour — will that work for the canary window?

mike: yes that'd be perfect, jonathan. what time can you stop it?

jonathan: can stop at 15:30 UTC, back by 18:00. want me to post a temporary tag on the job?

mike: please tag it with `temp-borrow-ukwest-1809` and add a short note in the PR. cheers.

claudia: FYI ops: show any capacity in uk-west baremetal pool? I can try a soft-claim if needed.

ops-lead: if vendor ETA > 48h we should open a procurement ticket and mark the canary as high priority. also set fallback to h100-spot if latency tolerable.

infra-bot: ticket #INFRA-7842 created for vendor follow-up (assigned: procurement).

mike: sara — can you confirm the region quota numbers after jonathan frees those nodes? also add a short terraform PR comment if we need to bump regional reservation?

sara: will check after 15:35 and paste the output. if quota still short, quick terraform hack is `terraform apply -target=module.reserve_region` but prefer manual borrow first.

jonathan: stopped smoke job at 15:30, tag applied.

sara: quota check pasted:```
QUOTA
A100_GPUS  limit: 12  usage: 11
```

sara: after freeing jonathan's 2 GPUs it shows:
```
A100_GPUS  limit: 12  usage: 9
```

mike: perfect — that covers the 4 we need. i'll kick off the canary at 16:00 UTC.

claudia: I'll keep an eye on billing delta. if vendor confirms rack earlier we can revert.

ops-lead: reminder — if performance dips, auto-failover policy is to route to eu-west1 A100 pool, set via route policy `canary-fallback-eu1`.

mike: thanks everyone :thumbsup: will update thread after canary.

jonathan: good luck! :rocket:

infra-bot: deploy-canary job started at 16:02 UTC (canary-id: cny-20240918-1809).
